plugins.description: Experimental: it may break with a bb update. Run bb threads on on-demand boat.dev sandboxes that stop when idle, resume on the same disk, and start from the boat saved snapshot, environment and size you pick in the composer, with bb's GitHub login or else boat's.
Wakes your Grok Bots by webhook when a bb thread needs attention: an open question or approval, a finished turn, or a failure.

A PR Reviews app on the left rail that lists a GitHub project's open pull requests and opens each one on a page with its whole diff in a file tree and a guided review, written by a review thread, that walks you through the change step by step. Its Summary shows the PR's activity, as GitHub's Conversation tab does, and every diff shows the PR's GitHub review threads where they belong. It posts to GitHub only the review comments, replies and conversation comments you write or pick from the guide, on your click; review threads never post to GitHub.
Agents answer data with an inline chart, without being asked, using bb's inline visualizations.

A live strip above the composer that counts the latest prompt's subagents and child threads, plus any still running, and how long they have taken, and opens into one row per subagent that expands to its report and latest steps and opens its full transcript in the side panel or its own thread; a Subagents tab in the side panel lists every subagent in the thread, grouped by the prompt it was launched after.
